about.zh: 你递给 AI 一张图，AMB 读出人物姿势（OpenPose），用和你底模对得上的控制网让新图摆出这个姿势。 OpenPose 认真人照片和 3D 图准，认二次元人物常常认错，二次元图用「照着构图画」更稳（参考工作流作者也这么说）。 画布上是 Anima 模型时，自动改用 Anima 专用的 LLLite 控制网（需要 ComfyUI-Anima-LLLite）。
about.en: From a picture you hand the AI, Anomalous reads the pose (OpenPose) and steers the picture with a ControlNet that fits your model. OpenPose reads photos and 3D well and anime characters often wrongly; for anime, Follow a layout is steadier (as the source's author says). On an Anima model it uses an Anima ControlNet-LLLite instead (needs ComfyUI-Anima-LLLite).

source.zh: 参考工作流的「底图控制网」组

after: run_workflow: the picture now takes that pose (strength 0.8, for the first 80% of the steps; lower either for a looser pose). The prompt still says who and what: change it if it fights the pose. If the picture came out ignoring the pose, OpenPose likely misread an anime picture: try control_depth.

anima.after: On this Anima model an Anima ControlNet-LLLite steers it, more gently than an SDXL ControlNet: say in the prompt what the picture shows (how many people, what they do), or the prompt wins. Strength 1.0 for all the steps; up to 1.5 holds it closer. run_workflow.
